'''José Sarukhán Kermez''' (born 15 July 1940) is a [[plant biologist]] and [[ecologist]]. He is currently the National Coordinator for Mexico's National Commission for Knowledge and Use of Biodiversity ([[Conabio|CONABIO]]). He received a B.A. from [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM) in 1964, a Masters from Postgraduate College ([[Chapingo Autonomous University|Chapingo]]), and a Ph.D. (Ecology) from the [[University of Wales]]. A known expert in the [[biodiversity]] of Mexico,<ref name="Ex">{{Cite web |url=http://m.excelsior.com.mx/nacional/2017/05/22/1165005/amp |title=José Sarukhán, el pilar de la biodiversidad en México |date=May 22, 2017 |publisher=excelsior.com.mx |access-date=November 28, 2017}}</ref>  Sarukhán's main interests include [[tropical ecology]], plant population ecology, and the systems ecology of both temperate and tropical ecosystems, as well as training and education.<ref name="Ex"/><ref name="COLNAL">{{Cite web |url=http://colnal.mx/members/jose-sarukhan |title=José Sarukhán |publisher=colnal.mx |access-date=November 28, 2017}}</ref> He has published over 110 research papers and authored and co-authored several books.

==Career==
Sarukhán was director of the Biology Institute at UNAM from 1979 to 1996. In 1987, he was appointed Vice Chancellor for Science at UNAM, and was Rector (President) from 1989 to 1997.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://news.stanford.edu/pr/98/980701sarukhan.html |title=The boundless |date=July 1, 1998 |publisher=stanford.edu |access-date=November 1, 2017}}</ref> He has been a professor in the Institute of Ecology since 1988 (emeritus since 2006). Sarukhán has been the driving force for the main ecological research group in Mexico and of the Ecology Institute at UNAM, which has more than 50 researchers and has produced more than 160 Ph.D. students, and for the Ecology Center in Morelia, Michoacán (CIECO).<ref name="COLNAL"/>

Sarukhán has served as president of the Botanical Society of Mexico and the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]], president of the Association for Tropical Biology, president of the Latin American Union of Universities (UDUAL), and Coordinator of the Red Latinoamericana de Botánica. He helped establish the National Commission on Biodiversity of México and was appointed as National Coordinator of CONABIO in 1992. From 2000 to 2002, he was the Commissioner of the Social and Human Development Cabinet of the Mexican government.<ref name="COLNAL"/><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://web.ecologia.unam.mx/index.php/investigadores/jose-sarukhan |title=José Sarukhán |publisher=unam.mx |access-date=November 28, 2017}}</ref>

==Fellowships==
Sarukhán has been elected a Fellow of many professional societies, including the [[Association for Tropical Biology and Conservation]] (1996), U.S. [[National Academy of Sciences]], the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]], the [[Royal Society]], the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]], the [[El Colegio Nacional (Mexico)|National College]], the Academia de Ciencias de América Latina and the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]].

==Awards and recognition==
Nine universities have awarded him honorary doctorates. He received the 2017 [[Tyler Prize for Environmental Achievement]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Mexican ecologist José Sarukhán wins 2017 Tyler Prize|url=https://news.mongabay.com/2017/05/mexican-ecologist-jose-sarukhan-wins-2017-tyler-prize/|website=Mongabay|access-date=9 November 2017|date=2017-05-03}}</ref>

José Sarukhán Kermez is the recipient of the Lifetime Achievement Award ([[Champions of the Earth]]) in 2016.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Programme |first1=UN Environment |title=All Laureates |url=https://www.unep.org/championsofearth/all-laureates?field_award_category_target_id=11 |website=Champions of the Earth |language=en}}</ref>

In 1990 the Mexican federal government awarded him the [[National Prize for Arts and Sciences (Mexico)|National Prize for Arts and Sciences]] in the Physics, Mathematics, and Natural Sciences category.<ref>{{cite web | last=Pública | first=Secretaría de Educación | title=José Sarukhán Kermez | website=gob.mx | date=2025-02-14 | url=https://www.gob.mx/sep/acciones-y-programas/jose-sarukhan-kermez?state=published | language=es | access-date=2025-06-11}}</ref>

In June 2025 he was appointed as {{lang|fr|Chevalier}} (Knight) of the [[French Legion of Honor]] by the French Government.<ref>{{cite web | title=Entregan 'Legión de Honor' al ex rector de UNAM, José Sarukhán, por su labor en favor de la naturaleza | website=Aristegui Noticias | date=2025-06-21 | url=https://aristeguinoticias.com/2106/naturaleza/entregan-legion-de-honor-al-ex-rector-de-unam-jose-sarukhan-por-su-labor-en-favor-de-la-naturaleza/ | language=es | access-date=2026-01-20}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Foreign civilians | website=legiondhonneur.fr | date=2025-04-22 | url=https://www.legiondhonneur.fr/sites/default/files/2025-04/lh-20241029-etrangers_0.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250422230458/https://www.legiondhonneur.fr/sites/default/files/2025-04/lh-20241029-etrangers_0.pdf | archive-date=2025-04-22 | url-status=live | access-date=2026-01-20}}</ref>
